discrepancies.title: Assumed continuation horizon (H=3) differs substantially from mean session length
discrepancies.observed_phenomenon: Configured horizon H=3 turns, but observed sessions averaged 9.8 requests (range 2-23).
discrepancies.policy_implication: A 3-turn break-even horizon underestimates the compound cost of a prefix invalidation on long-running 15-25 turn sessions.
discrepancies.recommendation: Allow dynamic horizon scaling based on task family and observed conversation turn count in Phase 2.
